## Welcome

The **CLEREVA Student Success Assistant** is a reproducible data analysis project
that applies statistical skills to the UCI *Student Performance* dataset
(Mathematics cohort, N = 394) to support academic counsellors in identifying
at-risk students and planning evidence-based interventions.

> **Responsible Use Reminder:** All findings in this project are based on
> observational data and represent *associations*, not causal effects. Model
> outputs are decision-support indicators — human review is always required
> before taking action.

---

## What This Project Does

This project implements six statistical skills, each answering a specific
operational question:

| # | Skill | Question |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | [Explore](explore.qmd) | What does student performance look like? |
| 2 | [Compare](compare.qmd) | Do student groups differ meaningfully? |
| 3 | [Model](model.qmd) | Which factors are associated with academic risk? |
| 4 | [Absence Analysis](absence-analysis.qmd) | How are absences related to final grades? |
| 5 | [Support Ranking](support-ranking.qmd) | Which students should be reviewed first? |
| 6 | [Scenario Analysis](scenario-analysis.qmd) | How would modelled risk change under alternatives? |

---

## Project Architecture

```
clereva-student-success-assistant/
├── R/               # Analysis scripts (one per skill)
├── .agents/skills/  # Agent skill definitions (auto-discovered)
├── data/            # Raw, processed, and output data
├── models/          # Trained model and performance metrics
├── tests/           # Validation unit tests + skill integration tests
└── docs/            # Rendered Quarto website (this site)
```

---

## Validation Layer

Every analysis script passes through a shared validation layer
([`R/validation.R`](R/validation.R)) that enforces:

- ✅ Required column presence and correct types
- ✅ Sample size thresholds (minimum 30 for CLT assumptions)
- ✅ Variable range bounds (grades 0–20, age 15–22, absences 0–100)
- ✅ Two-group structure for statistical comparisons
- ✅ Missingness detection
- ✅ Causal language prevention in narrative text
